name: Love at First Bite
source:
It's like any other night. You wake up late, head to a club, and ready to have some fun. But then, you see a girl across the room who seems to be eyeing you?

Wonder what she's all about...?

[From [url=https://uberthemeh.itch.io/love-at-first-bite]Itch.io[/url]]
